mistake_reason: At step 18, WebSurfer deviated from the core objective (mapping Excel tables to numbered references) and shifted focus to summarizing trans fat regulations and labeling policies in Turkey/EU. This caused the team to fixate on irrelevant policy details (steps 19–20), abandoning the necessary actions to obtain or reconstruct table-to-reference mappings. The derailment led to providing a placeholder sequential list (1–6) instead of working toward the correct reference numbers. This matches FM-2.3 Task Derailment: scope creep into unrelated subtopics, resulting in failure to accomplish the main task.
